hero.title: Share Cloud Native Days Italy
hero.lead: Logos, colors, templates and ready-made assets to talk about the event, the right way, without asking us first.

basics.title: Brand basics
basics.description: The essentials of the Cloud Native Days Italy identity. Mix and match as you like, just keep the logo as it is.
basics.boilerplate: Cloud Native Days Italy is a community-organized event dedicated to cloud native and open source technologies, gathering the Italian community of developers, architects, engineers and IT professionals for two days of talks, workshops and networking. The 2027 edition takes place in Bologna on 19-20 May 2027. Learn more at cloudnativedaysitaly.org.
basics.decorNote: The halftone and the rings are ours, take them. The decorative elements on our social cards (donuts, diamonds, stars, clouds) are licensed material we cannot redistribute: use the card generator to get graphics that include them. Extenda, our display typeface, is licensed too and never travels with the assets: the site renders Anton, free on Google Fonts.

designSystem.title: Design system
designSystem.description: Colours, typography, components and patterns, rendered with the real code of the website. Read it before designing a slide, a card or a page for the event: it shows what our design does, and what it never does.

mediaPartners.title: For media partners
mediaPartners.description: Everything you need to talk about the event on your channels.
offer: Your logo on the website and on the partners wall
We amplify your posts on our social channels
Ready-made cards and copy for your audience
ask: Share the event with your community
Publish the Call for Papers and ticket announcements
Use the official assets and boilerplate below

attendees.title: For attendees
attendees.description: Coming to the event? Say it loud. Grab an "I'll be there" card for your socials and tag @cloudnativedaysitaly.
attendees.note: An interactive generator to personalize your card is in the works.

speakers.title: For speakers
speakers.description: Selected as a speaker? Congrats! Here is what you need for your talk and your announcement.
guidelines: Use the official slide template, or at least its title and closing slides
16:9 format, minimum 24pt body text: the room is big
Add your social handle on the title slide, the audience will look for you
Live demos welcome, with a recorded backup (conference Wi-Fi is what it is)
speakers.note: Your personalized speaker announcement card is on us: we prepare it and send it to you before the announcement.

usage.title: The only rules

rules.text: Use the official logos, colors and templates, mix and match as you like
Tag @cloudnativedaysitaly so we can reshare your posts
Don't stretch, recolor or redraw the logo
Don't imply we endorse your product

usage.contact: Questions or something custom? Write us at org@cloudnativedaysitaly.org
